Description: Initialize Node.js package.json, Express server entry point, folder structure, and scripts
Acceptance Criteria: package.json with start/dev scripts, clean folder structure matching MVC pattern
Notes: Base setup required before any route or model

Description: Configure MongoDB Mongoose connection with retry logic, pooling, and event listeners

Description: Create .env.example, setup dotenv, helmet, cors, and express-rate-limit
Acceptance Criteria: All secrets parameterized, security middleware enabled on app

Description: Define Mongoose schemas for User and Admin with validation, indexing, and role distinction

Notes: Recommend unified User model with role field vs separate adminModel

Description: Implement secure bcrypt password hashing and comparison helper functions
Acceptance Criteria: Salt rounds >= 10, never store plaintext passwords, timing-safe compare

Description: Implement token generation (sign) and verification utilities with expiration
Acceptance Criteria: Tokens contain user id and role, signed with JWT_SECRET, 24h expiration

Description: POST /api/auth/register endpoint with input validation (express-validator)

Notes: Check email format, password min length 8

Description: POST /api/auth/login and POST /api/admin/login with credentials verification
Acceptance Criteria: Valid credentials return signed JWT, invalid credentials return 401 with generic message
Notes: Do not expose whether email exists on failed login

Description: Middleware to extract and verify Bearer token from Authorization header and attach user to req
Acceptance Criteria: Extracts token, attaches req.user, rejects missing/invalid/expired token with 401

Description: Middleware to restrict route access by role (e.g. admin vs user)
Acceptance Criteria: Allows matching role, returns 403 Forbidden for unauthorized roles

Description: GET /api/auth/profile and PUT /api/auth/profile for authenticated user profile view/edit
Acceptance Criteria: User can view and update own profile, cannot change role or password here
Evidence: API test for profile view and update
Notes: Password change should be separate flow

Description: Define Mongoose schema for Movie with title, genre, certification, runtime, releaseDate, poster, description
Acceptance Criteria: All fields validated, text indexes on title and genre for search
Notes: Certification enum: U, UA, A, R

Description: GET /api/movies with query filtering by genre, search query, release date, and pagination
Acceptance Criteria: Returns paginated list of movies, filtered by query params, 200 OK
Evidence: API tests with filtering and pagination

Description: GET /api/movies/:id with detailed movie info and current showtimes lookup
Acceptance Criteria: Returns single movie with 200, returns 404 for non-existent ID, handles invalid ObjectID
Notes: Validate mongo ID format before query

Description: POST /api/movies with full validation, poster upload/URL, restricted to Admin
Acceptance Criteria: Creates movie record, returns 201 Created, rejects missing required fields with 400

Description: PUT /api/movies/:id and DELETE /api/movies/:id restricted to Admin
Acceptance Criteria: Updates movie fields or deletes movie, handles active show references safely
Evidence: API tests for update and soft/hard delete
Notes: Check if shows exist before deleting movie

Description: Define Mongoose schema for Theatre with name, location, adminRef, tier seat counts, and pricing
Acceptance Criteria: Includes lower, middle, balcony counts and tier prices, validates positive integers
Notes: Proper ObjectId reference to Admin user

Description: CRUD endpoints /api/theatres for listing (public) and create/update/delete (admin)
Acceptance Criteria: Public can list theatres, admin can create and manage theatres
Evidence: API tests for public list and admin CRUD
Notes: Validate unique theatre names per location

Description: Define Mongoose schema for Show linking movie, theatre, date, time, tier pricing, and booked seats array
Acceptance Criteria: ObjectId refs to Movie and Theatre, compound index on theatre+date+time
Notes: Stores seat status / booked seats list

Description: POST /api/shows with conflict detection for theatre hall availability and movie runtime
Acceptance Criteria: Prevents overlapping show schedules at same theatre, returns 201 or 409 Conflict
Notes: Calculate end time = start time + runtime + 20min cleanup

Acceptance Criteria: Returns active shows matching filters, populated with theatre and movie details
Evidence: API tests with various date queries
Notes: Filter out past shows for current date

Description: Define Mongoose schema for Booking with userRef, showRef, selectedSeats array, totalAmount, status, timestamps

Description: GET /api/shows/:id/seats returning seat layout, tier pricing, and booked/available status
Acceptance Criteria: Calculates remaining seats per tier, returns list of reserved seat numbers
Notes: Layout based on theatre seat counts

Description: POST /api/bookings implementing atomic reservation with conditional update or MongoDB transaction
Acceptance Criteria: Prevents concurrent double booking of same seat, returns 201 or 409 Conflict

Description: GET /api/bookings/my-bookings and GET /api/bookings/:id with ownership verification
Acceptance Criteria: Users can only access their own bookings, returns full show, movie, and seat details

Description: PUT /api/bookings/:id/cancel with seat release and cancellation policy checks
Acceptance Criteria: Releases seats back to Show bookedSeats array, updates booking status to CANCELLED
Notes: Allowed only before show start time

Description: Define Favorite model and POST /api/favorites, DELETE /api/favorites/:id, GET /api/favorites
Acceptance Criteria: Unique compound index on userRef+movieRef, prevents duplicate favorites, populated movie data

Description: Define Review model with userRef, movieRef, rating (1-5), comment, and timestamps
Acceptance Criteria: Enforces 1 review per user per movie via unique index, rating integer 1 to 5

Description: POST /api/reviews, PUT /api/reviews/:id, DELETE /api/reviews/:id, GET /api/movies/:id/reviews
Acceptance Criteria: Users can CRUD own reviews, public can view movie reviews, admin can moderate/delete
Notes: Update movie average rating on hook

Description: GET /api/admin/stats returning total users, active bookings, gross revenue, movie counts

Description: GET /api/admin/bookings with filtering by status, date, theatre, and user
